_extraction_flags.notes: Comprehensive OW-ISAC framework using OPA (Optical Phased Array). Addresses 'multi-beam' issue (grating lobes) and turns it into a sensing advantage. Optimization of Precoding and PD Orientations.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig 1: OPA Beamforming process (Digital Precoding -> Laser -> Splitter -> EOPM -> Emitters). Fig 2: Huygens-Fresnel model. Fig 4: Sensing scanning operational principle. Fig 6: Optimal Beampatterns. Fig 12: RMSE for imaging vs SNR. Fig 13/14/15: Realistic ITS scenario simulation.
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: Proposed OPA-based OW-ISAC framework. Uses 'Multi-beam' property of OPA for multi-user Comm and Imaging. Problem: Grating lobes cause interference. Solution: Joint optimization of Precoding Matrices (W) and PD Orientations (phi) to maximize 'Contrast Metric' for Sensing and SINR for Comm.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: BER vs SNR curves (Fig 11). Sensing: RMSE converges to ~2-7 cm (asymptotic region) depending on SINR threshold. Imaging Profile demonstrated in ITS scenario.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: High-quality theoretical and simulation paper. Addresses specific OPA challenges (grating lobes) which are rare in RF-ISAC. Defines 'Light-Field SINR' and 'Contrast Metric'. Rigorous optimization (SDR, BCD).

bibliographic.title: Optical Wireless Integrated Sensing and Communication Based on Optical Phased Array: Performance Metric and Optimal Beamforming
bibliographic.authors: Yunfeng Wen, Fang Yang, Jian Song, Zhu Han

application.scenario_description: ITS scenario with OPA-based Base Station (BS) communicating with multiple vehicles (UEs) and imaging environment (barricades).

key_contribution.key_contribution: Joint optimization of OPA precoding and PD orientations for OW-ISAC. Derivation of 'Light-Field SINR' (Comm) and 'Contrast Metric' (Sensing). Exploitation of OPA multi-beam property.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Lack of beamforming optimization for OPA-based OW-ISAC that considers grating lobes and direct detection constraints.

transmitter.notes: 32-element OPA. Emitter distance 6.2 um. Total power 0.1 W.

receiver.notes: 7 Sensing PDs with optimized orientations. 2 Comm UEs.

waveform.notes: PSS-PPM waveform used for Comm (BER simulation).

channel_wireless.notes: Range up to ~30m in ITS scenario. Atmospheric attenuation 12 dB/km.

comm_metrics.notes: BER 10^-4 achieved at various Electrical SNR levels depending on SINR threshold.

tradeoff.notes: Trade-off between Comm SINR and Sensing Contrast (ISLR). Fig 8 shows ISLR increases (worse sensing) as Comm SINR demand increases.
